inbox.subject: Harborline Mutual: wave rollout accepted
inbox.body:
Alex,

Following yesterday's conversation, I'm confirming in writing that Harborline Mutual accepts the phased rollout in waves. Wave 1 opens January 1 with setup capped at 800 households. Wave 2 covers the remaining employees who sign up and opens once your care leads confirm capacity, which we understand is targeted for February. Pricing stays at $6 per employee per month across our 40,000 employees.

Our legal team will send the revised order form with the wave language early next week. Celeste Navarro will coordinate the employee communication schedule with your team. Signature is still subject to that review, so please hold any external communication until we've signed.

Talk at 1:30pm.

Diane Coleridge
VP, Total Rewards
Harborline Mutual

inbox.subject: Announce Harborline next week?
inbox.body:
Alex,

Saw Diane's note. I want to announce the Harborline partnership publicly next week, ideally Tuesday, November 24, before the holiday slows everything down. Draft release and a LinkedIn post are attached. It would give the employer pipeline a real logo to point to going into December, and two prospects asked about insurer partners this month.

Can we decide in our 10:30am?

Tomás

inbox.subject: Board follow-ups
inbox.body:
Alex,

Thanks for yesterday. Three things from the board:

1. Thank-you notes to the board members should go out today. Helen and Theo both stayed late for the Harborline discussion, worth naming that.
2. Draft minutes are in the board folder. Please review by Monday.
3. They want an updated year end forecast once Harborline is signed. Current gap to the $19M plan is $1.2M, burn multiple 2.8x trailing quarter.

Julian

inbox.subject: Boston backlog and wave 1 staffing
inbox.body:
Alex,

Boston backlog at 5am today was 39 handoffs, down from 47 yesterday. Keisha's team cleared most of the weekend scheduling queue.

On Harborline: with 48 care leads and the 3 Q1 offers accepted, we can hold the promise for 800 households from January 1. I'd like wave 2 not to open before February 15 so the new leads are fully ramped.

Jordan

inbox.subject: Privacy incident status
inbox.body:
Alex,

Still one open incident. Root cause confirmed, affected households notified, and I expect to close it Tuesday after the access review. No change needed before the Harborline order form, but I'll add a line to our security questionnaire answers.

Nadia

inbox.subject: Donna this week
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Your mom had a good week. Her flu shot is done and the new pharmacy delivery started Wednesday without a hitch. She mentioned feeling dizzy after standing up on Monday, so I booked a blood pressure check with her primary care doctor for Tuesday, December 1 at 10am. I'll go with her.

I'm out next Wednesday, so Tommy will cover anything urgent. Talk at 5pm tomorrow.

Erika

inbox.subject: VP of Care search: next steps
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for squeezing Theo in after the board last night. Jordan's notes are positive, and I'll send his feedback and next steps Monday. Maya Hollis is confirmed for Tuesday at 3pm with you and Jordan.

Overall pipeline is still down 17% from September since the two declines, so I'm widening the VP of Care search to two more agencies.

Best,
Grace Lindqvist
TalentBridge
